plainText:
Goh's Panpour (Japanese: ゴウのヒヤップ Go's Hiyappu) is the fifth that Goh in the Unova region and his eighty-third overall.

==In animation==
===History===
==== ====
 
In Thrash of the Titans!, Goh encountered and caught while visiting Opelucid City.

In Grabbing the Brass Ring!, Goh uses Panpour in a group with , , , and to help motivate the brass of a when it got split up. Initially, they had difficulty finding a sync, but after a few tries and Panpour steered along with Pansear, the group finally manages to unite.

In An Adventure of Mega Proportions!, Goh used Panpour whilst on Mega Island to keep Ash's Lucario cool in the vicinity of lava. Using Rain Dance, Goh took the opportunity to run away with Lucario and try to find . During the escape and with the help of Cinderace, Goh managed to capture a . After reaching a safe location, Goh called back Panpour to its .

In Big Brother to the Rescue!, had Panpour use its attack on Goh's Heracross to snap him out of its smitten trance over Goh's , although this only worked for a brief time before Heracross was smitten by 's scent.

In This Could be the Start of Something Big!, Panpour attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure. After that, it posed for a group photo with Goh, Ash, and the others.
 

===Personality and characteristics===
As first seen in Take My Thief! Please!, Panpour is often seen alongside in the Cerise Laboratory. This link between the two is seen again in Grabbing the Brass Ring!, when Panpour relies on Pansear to get his bearings on his quest to help the brass and during mealtime where the two join the queue together.

In celebration of the airing of JN100, the 100th episode of , the animated series Twitter page launched a series of audio dramas. In the second "Nighttime at the Sakuragi Park" , Pansear and Panpour are mentioned by while sleeping together with .
